core_objective: Answers: 'Given exact situation faced, what could batter reasonably have done differently?'
methodological_rules: Expected Runs is strictly a supporting statistical baseline, NEVER ground truth.
Counterfactual must NOT be created by assuming batter should score Expected Runs.
Realistic alternative constructed using: match phase, wickets remaining, current team RR, required RR, balls faced.
Demands realistic execution; does not ask for mathematically impossible bursts.

CF_Realistic_Par.description: Realistic scoring tempo for the specific phase and pressure level.
CF_Realistic_Par.death_overs_baseline_sr: 150.0 to 175.0 depending on exact entry over
CF_Realistic_Par.collapse_adjustment: -15 SR if wickets remaining <= 4 before over 14
CF_Realistic_Par.chase_adjustment: Scaled to required RR (capped at 165 SR for high RRR, floored at 115 SR for low RRR)

CF_Tactical_Acceleration.description: Realistic aggressive alternative (+15 to +20 SR or 1 extra boundary) where team needed urgent acceleration.

CF_Wicket_Preservation.description: Preserving wicket across the opportunity window (staying not out) when batting depth is scarce.

CF_Strike_Rotation.description: Converting 2-3 dot balls into singles to keep higher-tempo partner on strike.

retrospective_analysis_principle: Post-match data evaluates what occurred after exit, but strictly separates observed match outcome from counterfactual estimation.
